notes.title: Version 1.3.0 - Chinese localization and price reduction
notes.content:
The languages of Costly Adventure have a new friend: Chinese. Much gratitude goes to 灰飞烟灭化为黑夜 and 太阳花BASARA. And that's not all. Celebrating this awesome addition, we are reducing the price of Costly Adventure in China to ¥ 10. Enjoy!

[b]Full patch notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added full Chinese localization
[*] Reworked language selection in Options menu
[*] HUD elements, damage numbers and couple other texts now use original pixel font when localization is not needed
[/list]

tags.feature: [*] Reworked language selection in Options menu

notes.title: Version 1.2 - Spanish localization
notes.content:
Costly Adventure is now available in Spanish! Huge thanks goes to Ana Alcocer Alcántara.

[b]Full patch notes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Added full Spanish localization
[*] A couple of typo fixes for German localization
[*] Inspect tooltips got a bit bigger to accommodate new localization
[*] A few other minor UI changes
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.1 - German localization
notes.content:
Thanks to wonderful work of Iwan Gabovitch, Costly Adventure is now available in German!

[b]Full patch notes[/b]:
[list]
[*] Added full German localization
[*] Fixed score screen layout in non-English languages
[*] Blessing of Crown now properly displays tooltip in Inspect mode after loading
[*] Options screen now has dropdown list for languages instead of slider
[*] Various UI fixes for localization
[/list]

Blessing of Crown now properly displays tooltip in Inspect mode after loading
